fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole 16 ft runabout powerboat with outboard and trailer.
findings: Hull sides look dull and flat rather than glossy, with a slightly chalky look on the gray and white gelcoat along the port and starboard sides
Light grime and discoloration on the white transom and swim platform area around the outboard
Outboard cowling looks faded and dull
Gray carpet on the cockpit floor looks dusty and worn-looking
Light blue vinyl seats show some dirt and dullness on the seat backs and cushions
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 1984 Conroy. The hull sides and transom look a bit dull in the photos, and the cockpit carpet and blue seats could use a cleaning. We do pre-sale boat details with gelcoat polish and interior cleaning, and we come to you. Would you like a quote?
